messages.content: User task: Configure a trap handler for the network monitoring system

raw_response:
I'll help you configure a trap handler for your network monitoring system. This typically involves setting up SNMP trap receivers, defining trap destinations, configuring community strings, and establishing alerting thresholds.

PLAN: Identify the network monitoring platform (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix, PRTG, SolarWinds) to determine trap configuration syntax
PLAN: Define trap receiver IP addresses and ports (typically UDP 162) for SNMP trap collection
PLAN: Configure SNMP community strings and authentication (v2c/v3) for trap acceptance
PLAN: Set up trap filtering rules to categorize by severity (critical, warning, info) and source device types
PLAN: Configure alerting actions (email, SMS, webhook, ticketing integration) per trap category
PLAN: Test trap delivery using snmptrap command or vendor-specific simulator
PLAN: Document trap OID mappings and escalation procedures for operations team
